upcoming.overview: A young girl, Chihiro, becomes trapped in a strange new world of spirits. When her parents undergo a mysterious transformation, she must call upon the courage she never knew she had to free her family.

Armed with experimental technology, lethal combat skills, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz wages a one-man war against an enemy that never saw him coming.

upcoming.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
upcoming.original_title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
upcoming.overview: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

upcoming.title: Fjord
upcoming.overview: After moving from Romania to a remote Norwegian village to rebuild their lives, a family finds hope in their welcoming neighbors, but their fragile new beginning is threatened when their young daughter arrives at school covered in bruises.

upcoming.title: Angel and the Badman

upcoming.title: Blue Lock
upcoming.overview: A secret training program is established by the Japan Football Union to scout the world’s greatest striker after several years of defeat for the national team. The price of failure is absolute: those eliminated are permanently banned from ever joining the National Team.

upcoming.title: Wild Horse Nine

upcoming.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
upcoming.overview: Ten years after the events of the original, a reprogrammed T-800 is sent back in time to protect young John Connor from the shape-shifting T-1000. Together with his mother Sarah, he fights to stop Skynet from triggering a nuclear apocalypse.

upcoming.title: The Beast

upcoming.title: Flywheel: Ignition of the Soul
